doc_section: Check if Notifications are set to
steps:
1. Check if Notifications are set to None
Procedure
Locate the Notifications icon in the upper-right corner of the Oracle Fusion page.
Click the Notifications icon.
Click Show All in the notification popup window.
The Worklist page opens.
Click the logged-in username near the upper-right area of the Worklist page.
Select Administration from the dropdown menu.
Scroll downward until the Notifications section becomes visible.
Locate the Notification Mode dropdown.
Set Notification Mode to None.
Click Save near the lower-right section of the page.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
